Details: The test `testGenerateURLFragment` checks whether HTML entities such as `"` are correctly escaped to their corresponding character by the `StandardToolTipTagFragmentGenerator.generateToolTipFragment` method. However, the test failure indicates that this is not the case. Consequently, un-escaped strings are being returned, which leads to the error demonstrated by the test.

After providing this diagnosis, you will be prompted to suggest which methods would be the best locations to be fixed. The test `testChiSquareLargeTestStatistic` in the class `TestUtilsTest` is calling the method `TestUtils.chiSquare(double[], long[])`. This method is then delegating to `ChiSquareTestImpl.chiSquareTest(double[], long[])`. The `ChiSquareTestImpl.chiSquareTest` method sets the degrees of freedom based on the length of the expected array and then calculates the chi-square statistic by utilizing the `chiSquare` method from the same class. The calculation of the chi-square test statistic is based on the cumulative probability of the chi-square distribution.

Based on the test's assertion, it is expecting a chi-square test statistic value of approximately `114875.90421929007`, with a delta tolerance of `1E-9`.

The issue seems to be related to the calculation of the chi-square test statistic, as the expected value does not match the actual computed value. Further investigation is needed to determine the root cause of this discrepancy.

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug.
